label: MiMo V2.6 Pro Ultraspeed
note: MiMo V2.6 Pro on Xiaomi's Ultraspeed route: about 320 to 345 output tokens per second (measured, versus about 62 on the normal route), first token after about 1 s. Ten times the price of the normal Pro: 4.35 USD per million input tokens and 8.70 USD per million output tokens.
